prayerExcerpt.en-US: May we faithfully serve the Gospel, becoming all things to all.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Sirvamos fielmente o Evangelho, tornando-nos tudo para todos.

meta.face: A lean man of about thirty, slight and a little stooped, with an olive, sun-tanned complexion and a face broad at the forehead and narrowing to a small, pointed chin — a long, thin, straight nose, blue-grey eyes set rather close under light, slightly arched brows, hollow cheeks under modest cheekbones and a wide mouth; short straight dark-brown hair, a sparse, thin dark beard along the jaw (not full), and eyes lowered to the sand with a cheerful, kindly half-smile.
meta.basis: Simão de Vasconcelos's written portrait (medium height, thin, olive-skinned, bluish eyes, broad forehead, long nose, sparse beard, cheerful face), at the age he wrote the Poem to the Virgin on the beach of Iperoig (1563, aged 29); Benedito Calixto's paintings give the scene and the black soutane.
